lines.trans: First into the tin goes the COMPLETE berry almond cake recipe—both halves together!
Did you seal it in waterproof plastic AND write HONEY AND ORANGE ZEST in capitals?!
Future bakers thirty summers from tonight deserve zero ink smudges and zero soup ladles!
Next, here is a clean signed copy of our Courtyard Waltz and four-hand duet.
And from Javier and me: birch clothespin number nine, signed on the back by everyone!
Oh, look what our Room Eight mapmaker just sent in with Carmen to add on top!
While we played piano, he sketched all twenty-eight of us under the rooftop lanterns!
Look at Mateo standing by the doorway pretending not to smile in charcoal!
Tuck a small packet of dried courtyard mint leaves in the corner for a sweet smell.

words.gloss: corner (outer street corner or cake corner)

lines.trans: Thirty summers from now, someone will lift this lid and smell warm summer tea.
Lid pressed down snug, white cloth tape around the rim—ready for the waxed linen!
Let us carry it out under the lanterns while the third stone is still waiting!
First into the tin goes the COMPLETE berry almond cake recipe—both halves together!
Did you seal it in waterproof plastic AND write HONEY AND ORANGE ZEST in capitals?!
Future bakers thirty summers from tonight deserve zero ink smudges and zero soup ladles!
Next, here is a clean signed copy of our Courtyard Waltz and four-hand duet.
And from Javier and me: birch clothespin number nine, signed on the back by everyone!
From Javier; on behalf of Javier.
Oh, look what our Room Eight mapmaker just sent in with Carmen to add on top!
While we played piano, he sketched all twenty-eight of us under the rooftop lanterns!
Look at Mateo standing by the doorway pretending not to smile in charcoal!
Tuck a small packet of dried courtyard mint leaves in the corner for a sweet smell.

words.gloss: corner (outer street corner or cake corner)

lines.trans: Thirty summers from now, someone will lift this lid and smell warm summer tea.
Lid pressed down snug, white cloth tape around the rim—ready for the waxed linen!
Let us carry it out under the lanterns while the third stone is still waiting!
First into the tin goes the COMPLETE berry almond cake recipe—both halves together!

Future bakers thirty summers from tonight deserve zero ink smudges and zero soup ladles!
Next, here is a clean signed copy of our Courtyard Waltz and four-hand duet.

Tuck a small packet of dried courtyard mint leaves in the corner for a sweet smell.

words.gloss: corner (outer street corner or cake corner)

lines.trans: Thirty summers from now, someone will lift this lid and smell warm summer tea.
Lid pressed down snug, white cloth tape around the rim—ready for the waxed linen!
Let us carry it out under the lanterns while the third stone is still waiting!
See you later!

meanings.note: Marks destination, clock time, and animate direct objects (personal a).

examples.text: Vamos a la estación ahora.
examples.trans: We are going to the station now.

examples.text: El desayuno empieza a las ocho.
examples.trans: Breakfast starts at eight o'clock.

acabar.gloss: to finish; to have just (acabar de)

meanings.en: to finish; to have just (acabar de)
meanings.note: Acabar de + infinitive means 'to have just done something'.

examples.text: Acabo de llegar del mercado.
examples.trans: I have just arrived from the market.

examples.text: Ya acabamos el trabajo de hoy.
examples.trans: We already finished today's work.

meanings.note: Feminine noun that takes el in the singular before stressed initial /a/ (el agua fría).

examples.text: Quiero un vaso de agua fría.
examples.trans: I want a glass of cold water.

examples.text: El agua de la ducha sale caliente.
examples.trans: The shower water comes out hot.

meanings.note: Refers exclusively to people.

examples.text: Alguien acaba de llamar a la puerta.
examples.trans: Someone just knocked at the door.

examples.text: ¿Hay alguien en recepción?
examples.trans: Is anyone at the front desk?

meanings.note: Classic Mediterranean baking ingredient in tarts and biscuits.

examples.text: Rocío hornea galletas crujientes de almendra y limón.
examples.trans: Rocio bakes crunchy almond and lemon biscuits.

examples.text: Tostamos las almendras cinco minutos en el horno.
examples.trans: We toast the almonds for five minutes in the oven.

meanings.note: Followed by de before a noun: alrededor de la mesa ('around the table').

examples.text: Pusimos seis sillas alrededor de la mesa grande.
examples.trans: We placed six chairs around the big table.

examples.text: Miró alrededor para saludar a todos los amigos.
examples.trans: She looked around to greet all the friends.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender with the two items it refers to: ambos (masculine/mixed) and ambas (feminine).

examples.text: Pegamos etiquetas rojas en ambos tarros de cristal.
examples.trans: We stuck red labels on both glass jars.

examples.text: Conozco a los dos hermanos y ambos cocinan muy bien.
examples.trans: I know both brothers and both of them cook very well.

meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (e -> ie: aprieto).

examples.text: Aprieto bien el tapón del termo.
examples.trans: I tighten the thermos cap firmly.

examples.text: Apretó el botón del timbre dos veces.
examples.trans: He pressed the doorbell button twice.

meanings.note: Right where the speaker is.

examples.text: Aquí tiene su llave.
examples.trans: Here is your key.

examples.text: Nos sentamos aquí bajo el árbol.
examples.trans: We sit right here under the tree.

meanings.note: Accented aún is interchangeable with todavía.

examples.text: El café aún está caliente.
examples.trans: The coffee is still hot.

examples.text: Aún no han abierto la puerta.
examples.trans: They have not opened the door yet.

meanings.note: Bajo llave means 'under lock and key'; as an adjective (bajo/baja), means 'low' or 'ground' (planta baja).

examples.text: Nos sentamos bajo el limonero.
examples.trans: We sit under the lemon tree.

examples.text: Guarda la caja bajo llave.
examples.trans: Keep the box under lock and key.

meanings.note: Before an adjective (bien caliente), means 'nice and hot'.

examples.text: Todo va muy bien hoy.
examples.trans: Everything is going very well today.

examples.text: El té sale bien caliente.
examples.trans: The tea comes out nice and hot.

meanings.note: Quedarse blanco means 'to go pale'.

examples.text: Es una pieza blanca.
examples.trans: It is a white piece.

examples.text: Mira, hay un sobre blanco doblado en el asa.
examples.trans: Look, there is a folded white envelope on the handle.

meanings.note: Masculine noun (el borde de la mesa / de la ventana).

examples.text: No dejes el vaso lleno tan cerca del borde.
examples.trans: Do not leave the full glass so close to the edge.

examples.text: Lijamos suaves los bordes de madera antes de pintar.
examples.trans: We sanded the wooden edges smooth before painting.

meanings.note: Feminine form: la cartógrafa.

examples.text: El cartógrafo dibujó cada calle estrecha del casco antiguo.
examples.trans: The mapmaker drew every narrow street of the old quarter.

examples.text: Aquel viajero era un joven cartógrafo que hacía mapas a mano.
examples.trans: That traveller was a young mapmaker who drew maps by hand.

meanings.note: Covers beeswax (cera de abejas), candle wax, and sealing wax on letters (un sello de cera roja).

examples.text: El sobre antiguo lleva un sello de cera roja.
examples.trans: The old envelope bears a red wax seal.

examples.text: La tela con cera protege el paquete de la lluvia.
examples.trans: The waxed cloth protects the parcel from the rain.

meanings.note: Used for numbers, temperatures, and emphatic 'zero!'.

examples.text: Hoy tenemos cero problemas.
examples.trans: Today we have zero problems.

examples.text: El marcador está a cero.
examples.trans: The score is at zero.

meanings.note: Adjective from cerrar.

examples.text: Es una pieza cerrada.
examples.trans: It is a closed piece.

examples.text: ¡Buenos días! Disculpe, ¿está cerrada la puerta?
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

meanings.note: Silk ribbon or adhesive tape.

examples.text: La cinta está aquí.
examples.trans: The ribbon is here.

examples.text: Vemos las cintas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the ribbons from the door.

meanings.note: Por completo = completely; a jornada completa = full-time.

examples.text: Es una pieza completa.
examples.trans: It is a complete piece.

examples.text: a jornada completa
examples.trans: full-time

meanings.note: Combines with mí/ti to form conmigo ('with me') and contigo ('with you').

examples.text: Tomo café con leche caliente.
examples.trans: I take coffee with hot milk.

examples.text: Habla con calma, por favor.
examples.trans: Speak calmly, please.

meanings.note: Indicates physical contact or contrast.

examples.text: Apoya la escalera contra la pared.
examples.trans: Lean the ladder against the wall.

examples.text: Los farolillos brillan contra el cielo.
examples.trans: The lanterns glow against the sky.

meanings.note: Feminine noun used for paper copies, spare keys (copia de la llave), and backups.

examples.text: Guardé una copia de la receta en el cajón de la cocina.
examples.trans: I kept a copy of the recipe in the kitchen drawer.

examples.text: ¿Me haces una copia de la llave del portón, por favor?
examples.trans: Will you make me a copy of the gate key, please?

meanings.note: Invariable cardinal number.

examples.text: Tenemos cuatro mesas dentro.
examples.trans: We have four tables inside.

examples.text: La habitación cuatro da al patio.
examples.trans: Room four looks out onto the courtyard.

meanings.note: Table or soup spoon; cucharita is a teaspoon.

examples.text: Pon una cuchara limpia junto a cada cuenco.
examples.trans: Set a clean spoon beside each bowl.

examples.text: Prueba la sopa de lentejas con esta cuchara.
examples.trans: Taste the lentil soup with this spoon.

meanings.note: Describes warm sound, light, or hospitality.

examples.text: Es una pieza cálida.
examples.trans: It is a warm piece.

examples.text: Enchufa la lámpara de latón de Mateo... ¡ay, mira qué luz amarilla tan cálida!
examples.trans: Plug in Mateo's brass lamp... oh, look how warm that yellow light is!

meanings.note: Links possession, origin, material (de madera), and contents (taza de té).

examples.text: Es una mesa redonda de madera.
examples.trans: It is a round wooden table.

examples.text: Vengo de la estación de tren.
examples.trans: I am coming from the train station.

meanings.note: Mandatory contraction of preposition de + masculine article el.

examples.text: El bizcocho acaba de salir del horno.
examples.trans: The cake just came out of the oven.

examples.text: Soy vecino del barrio.
examples.trans: I am a neighbour from the quarter.

meanings.note: Dentro de + time means 'in (after) a certain amount of time'.

examples.text: Hay cuatro mesas dentro.
examples.trans: There are four tables inside.

examples.text: Vuelvo dentro de diez minutos.
examples.trans: I will be back in ten minutes.

meanings.note: Después de + noun/infinitive means 'after'.

examples.text: Hablamos después del desayuno.
examples.trans: We will talk after breakfast.

examples.text: ¿Qué hacemos después de eso?
examples.trans: What do we do after that?

meanings.note: Detrás de + noun means 'behind something'.

examples.text: El jardín está detrás de la casa.
examples.trans: The garden is behind the house.

examples.text: Hay otra página detrás del aviso.
examples.trans: There is another page behind the notice.

meanings.note: Regular -ar verb; the noun is el dibujo, a drawing.

examples.text: Mi hija dibuja un gato.
examples.trans: My daughter is drawing a cat.

examples.text: ¿Me dibujas el camino al hotel?
examples.trans: Will you sketch me the way to the hotel?

meanings.note: Same form for masculine and feminine; los dulces = sweets/pastries.

examples.text: Es una pieza dulce.
examples.trans: It is a sweet piece.

examples.text: ¿Podemos servir mantequilla salada con mermelada dulce de fresa?
examples.trans: Can we serve salted butter with sweet strawberry jam?

meanings.note: Plural los dúos.

examples.text: El dúo está aquí.
examples.trans: The duet is here.

examples.text: Vemos los dúos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the duets from the door.

meanings.note: Definite article; also appears before feminine nouns starting with stressed /a/ (el agua, el asa).

examples.text: El patio tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The courtyard has plenty of light.

examples.text: Pásame el libro de reservas.
examples.trans: Pass me the reservation book.

meanings.note: Expresses location inside or on top of a surface (en la mesa = on the table).

examples.text: Las tazas están en la mesa.
examples.trans: The cups are on the table.

examples.text: Vivimos en Valencia todo el año.
examples.trans: We live in Valencia all year.

meanings.note: Por encima = on top / over the surface.

examples.text: Pon azúcar glas por encima.
examples.trans: Put powdered sugar on top.

examples.text: Hay un cartel encima de la puerta.
examples.trans: There is a sign above the door.

entrar.gloss: to come in; to go in; to enter

meanings.en: to come in; to go in; to enter
meanings.note: Pairs with en in Spain (entrar en la posada).

examples.text: Entra mucha luz por el balcón.
examples.trans: Plenty of light comes in through the balcony.

examples.text: Entramos en la tienda para resguardarnos.
examples.trans: We stepped into the shop to shelter.

meanings.note: Regular -ir verb with irregular past participle escrito.

examples.text: Escribo la nota con lápiz azul.
examples.trans: I write the note in blue pencil.

examples.text: Mi hermano me escribió una postal corta.
examples.trans: My brother wrote me a short postcard.

esperar.gloss: to wait; to wait for; to hope

meanings.en: to wait; to wait for; to hope
meanings.note: Covers both 'wait (for)' and 'hope'.

examples.text: Espere un momento, por favor.
examples.trans: Wait a moment, please.

examples.text: Esperamos que descanse muy bien.
examples.trans: We hope you rest very well.

esquina.gloss: corner (outer street corner or cake corner)

meanings.en: corner (outer street corner or cake corner)
meanings.note: Outer corner where two streets meet, or the crisp corner of a baking tray.

examples.text: La esquina está aquí.
examples.trans: The corner is here.

examples.text: Vemos las esquinas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the corners from the door.

meanings.note: Pairs with locations (está en el patio) and temporary states (está caliente).

examples.text: El desayuno ya está listo.
examples.trans: Breakfast is ready now.

examples.text: ¿Dónde están las llaves de latón?
examples.trans: Where are the brass keys?

meanings.note: Forms: este (m sg), esta (f sg), estos (m pl), estas (f pl).

examples.text: Este patio es muy tranquilo.
examples.trans: This courtyard is very quiet.

examples.text: Esta mañana hace mucho sol.
examples.trans: This morning it is very sunny.

meanings.note: Festive hanging lantern strung across Spanish courtyards.

examples.text: El farolillo está aquí.
examples.trans: The paper lantern is here.

examples.text: Vemos los farolillos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the paper lanterns from the door.

meanings.note: Regular -ar verb.

examples.text: Firmo el recibo en la esquina.
examples.trans: I sign the receipt in the corner.

examples.text: Firmaron el nuevo contrato esta mañana.
examples.trans: They signed the new contract this morning.

meanings.note: While la fruta is everyday table fruit, masculine el fruto appears in culinary groupings like frutos rojos ('red summer berries') and frutos secos ('nuts and dried fruit').

examples.text: Horneamos un bizcocho de almendra y frutos rojos.
examples.trans: We baked an almond and summer berry sponge cake.

examples.text: El limonero da sus mejores frutos en primavera.
examples.trans: The lemon tree bears its finest fruit in spring.

meanings.note: Por fuera = on the outside.

examples.text: Hace frío fuera esta mañana.
examples.trans: It is cold outside this morning.

examples.text: La maleta es azul por fuera.
examples.trans: The suitcase is blue on the outside.

examples.text: Mi amor, no pasa nada, tienes aquí un futuro muy bonito. Te lo prometo.
examples.trans: My love, it's alright, you have a lovely future right here. I promise you.

examples.text: Pues vamos a ver ese futuro. ¿Qué pasa con el trabajo?
examples.trans: Well let's see that future. What about work?

examples.text: Por el futuro.
examples.trans: To the future.

grande.gloss: big; large; great (gran before sg noun)

meanings.en: big; large; great (gran before sg noun)
meanings.note: Shortens to gran before any singular noun (un gran libro, una gran idea).

examples.text: Tenemos una mesa grande en el patio.
examples.trans: We have a big table in the courtyard.

examples.text: Es una gran noticia para todos.
examples.trans: It is great news for everyone.

meanings.note: Impersonal present form hay means 'there is / there are'; haber que + infinitive = must / need to.

examples.text: Hay pan caliente en la cocina.
examples.trans: There is warm bread in the kitchen.

examples.text: Ya hemos preparado las habitaciones.
examples.trans: We have already prepared the rooms.

meanings.note: Plural habitaciones.

examples.text: La habitación está aquí.
examples.trans: The room is here.

examples.text: Vemos las habitaciones desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the rooms from the door.

meanings.note: ¡Hasta luego! = See you later!; ¡Hasta mañana! = See you tomorrow!

examples.text: Sigue recto hasta el puente.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead as far as the bridge.

examples.text: Nos quedamos hasta el viernes.
examples.trans: We are staying until Friday.

meanings.note: Means both a tree leaf and a single sheet of paper.

examples.text: La hoja está aquí.
examples.trans: The leaf is here.

examples.text: Vemos las hojas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the leaves from the door.

meanings.note: Followed directly by an infinitive (intenté sonreír).

examples.text: Intento aprender diez palabras al día.
examples.trans: I try to learn ten words a day.

examples.text: Intenté llamarte ayer por la tarde.
examples.trans: I tried calling you yesterday afternoon.

meanings.note: Junto a + noun works like a preposition meaning 'beside / next to'.

examples.text: Siéntate junto a la ventana.
examples.trans: Sit next to the window.

examples.text: Trabajamos juntos en la posada.
examples.trans: We work together at the guesthouse.

meanings.note: Definite feminine singular article before nouns; direct-object feminine pronoun before/attached to verbs.

examples.text: La puerta del patio es azul.
examples.trans: The courtyard door is blue.

examples.text: La habitación tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The room has plenty of light.

meanings.note: De lata means 'made of tin / tinplate' (una caja de lata); una lata also means a food can.

examples.text: Mi abuela guardaba los botones en una caja redonda de lata.
examples.trans: My grandmother kept buttons in a round tin box.

examples.text: Abrimos una lata de aceitunas para el aperitivo.
examples.trans: We opened a tin of olives for the snack.

meanings.note: Tu letra means 'your handwriting'.

examples.text: La letra está aquí.
examples.trans: The handwriting is here.

examples.text: Vemos las letras desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the handwritings from the door.

levantar.gloss: to lift; to raise; to get up (levantarse)

meanings.en: to lift; to raise; to get up (levantarse)
meanings.note: Regular -ar verb.

examples.text: Levanta esa esquina de la alfombra.
examples.trans: Lift that corner of the rug.

examples.text: Nos levantamos a las seis y media.
examples.trans: We get up at six thirty.

meanings.note: Opposite of sucio (dirty).

examples.text: Es una pieza limpia.
examples.trans: It is a clean piece.

examples.text: Aquí tiene un paño limpio y agua fría, Ernesto.
examples.trans: Here is a clean cloth and cold water, Ernesto.

meanings.note: De lino means 'made of linen' (manteles blancos de lino).

examples.text: Planchamos cuatro manteles blancos de lino para las mesas del patio.
examples.trans: We ironed four white linen tablecloths for the courtyard tables.

examples.text: Una camisa de lino es muy fresca para los días de verano.
examples.trans: A linen shirt is very cool for summer days.

meanings.note: With estar, means 'ready / all set'; with ser, means 'smart'.

examples.text: El té caliente ya está listo.
examples.trans: The hot tea is ready now.

examples.text: Es una arquitecta muy lista.
examples.trans: She is a very smart architect.

llevar.gloss: to carry; to wear; to take; to spend (time)

meanings.en: to carry; to wear; to take; to spend (time)
meanings.note: Versatile verb for carrying items, wearing clothes/glasses, or duration.

examples.text: Llevo dos tazas calientes al jardín.
examples.trans: I carry two hot cups to the garden.

examples.text: Hoy lleva un abrigo gris oscuro.
examples.trans: Today he is wearing a dark grey coat.

lo.gloss: it / him (direct object); the (neuter before adj/que)

meanings.en: it / him (direct object); the (neuter before adj/que)
meanings.note: Direct object pronoun before verbs (lo veo), and neuter article in lo que ('what') or lo mejor ('the best').

examples.text: Ya lo veo encima del estante.
examples.trans: I see it now on the shelf.

examples.text: Lo mejor del patio es la calma.
examples.trans: The best part of the courtyard is the calm.

meanings.note: Los viernes means 'every Friday / on Fridays'.

examples.text: Los vecinos vienen a desayunar.
examples.trans: The neighbours come for breakfast.

examples.text: Daba clases de piano los viernes.
examples.trans: She taught piano lessons on Fridays.

meanings.note: ¡Hasta luego! is Spain's most common everyday farewell.

examples.text: Cruza el puente y luego gira.
examples.trans: Cross the bridge and then turn.

examples.text: ¡Hasta luego, que tengas buen día!
examples.trans: See you later, have a good day!

meanings.note: Plural los lápices; a lápiz = in pencil.

examples.text: El lápiz está aquí.
examples.trans: The pencil is here.

examples.text: Vemos los lápices desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the pencils from the door.

meanings.note: De madera = wooden.

examples.text: La madera está aquí.
examples.trans: The wood is here.

examples.text: Vemos las maderas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the woods from the door.

meanings.note: Everyday noun related to manchar ('to stain').

examples.text: Esa mancha fresca de pintura sale con agua templada.
examples.trans: That fresh smudge of paint comes out with warm water.

examples.text: Revisa que los manteles blancos no tengan ninguna mancha.
examples.trans: Check that the white tablecloths do not have a single stain.

meanings.note: Everyday synonym of enviar.

examples.text: Te mando un mensaje cuando llegue.
examples.trans: I will send you a message when I arrive.

examples.text: Mi primo me mandó naranjas de Valencia.
examples.trans: My cousin sent me oranges from Valencia.

meanings.note: Feminine despite ending in -o: la mano, las manos; a mano derecha = on your right-hand side.

examples.text: Gira después de la farmacia a mano derecha.
examples.trans: Turn past the pharmacy on your right-hand side.

examples.text: Tengo las manos limpias.
examples.trans: My hands are clean.

meanings.note: Té de menta = mint tea.

examples.text: La menta es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The mint is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre la menta.
examples.trans: We talk about the mint.

meanings.note: Irregular 1st sg merezco.

examples.text: Este café merece cinco estrellas.
examples.trans: This coffee deserves five stars.

examples.text: Después de correr, mereces un descanso.
examples.trans: After running, you deserve a rest.

meter.gloss: to put in; to tuck in

meanings.en: to put in; to tuck in
meanings.note: Everyday Spanish verb specifically for putting something inside a pocket, bag, or drawer.

examples.text: Meto las llaves en el bolsillo.
examples.trans: I put the keys in my pocket.

examples.text: Metimos las sillas dentro por la lluvia.
examples.trans: We brought the chairs inside because of the rain.

meanings.note: Feminine noun: la miel.

examples.text: La miel es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The honey is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre la miel.
examples.trans: We talk about the honey.

meanings.note: Links two simultaneous actions.

examples.text: Espera aquí mientras abro la puerta.
examples.trans: Wait here while I open the door.

examples.text: Preparo el té mientras sale el pan.
examples.trans: I make the tea while the bread comes out.

mirar.gloss: to look; to look at; to watch

meanings.en: to look; to look at; to watch
meanings.note: Needs no preposition for 'at' (mira el reloj = look at the clock).

examples.text: Mira qué sol hace esta mañana.
examples.trans: Look how sunny it is this morning.

examples.text: Miramos el mapa antes de salir.
examples.trans: We look at the map before going out.

meanings.note: A mitad de precio = at half price.

examples.text: La mitad está aquí.
examples.trans: The half is here.

examples.text: Vemos las mitades desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the halves from the door.

meanings.note: Stressed possessive (el mío, la mía, los míos, las mías); ¡Madre mía! = Goodness me!

examples.text: Esa maleta azul es mía.
examples.trans: That blue suitcase is mine.

examples.text: Un amigo mío vive en esta calle.
examples.trans: A friend of mine lives on this street.

meanings.note: Zumo de naranja = orange juice.

examples.text: La naranja está aquí.
examples.trans: The orange is here.

examples.text: Vemos las naranjas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the oranges from the door.

meanings.note: Café solo / negro = black coffee.

examples.text: Es una pieza negra.
examples.trans: It is a black piece.

examples.text: ¡Buenos días de nuevo, señora Carmen! ¿Quiere café o té negro?
examples.trans: Good morning again, Madam Carmen! Would you like coffee or black tea?

meanings.note: Placed directly before the verb (or object pronouns) to negate a sentence.

examples.text: Hoy no llueve en Valencia.
examples.trans: Today it is not raining in Valencia.

examples.text: No se preocupe por la hora.
examples.trans: Do not worry about the time.

nos.gloss: us; to us; each other (¡Nos vemos!)

meanings.en: us; to us; each other (¡Nos vemos!)
meanings.note: First-person plural object/reflexive/reciprocal pronoun.

examples.text: ¡Nos vemos mañana por la mañana!
examples.trans: See you tomorrow morning!

examples.text: Nos alegra mucho la noticia.
examples.trans: The news makes us very glad.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender and number with the thing possessed (nuestro patio, nuestra posada).

examples.text: Nuestra posada tiene ocho habitaciones.
examples.trans: Our guesthouse has eight rooms.

examples.text: Nuestros vecinos toman café aquí.
examples.trans: Our neighbours have coffee here.

meanings.note: Las nueve = nine o'clock.

examples.text: El tren llega a las nueve en punto.
examples.trans: The train arrives at nine on the dot.

examples.text: Vimos un nueve sobre diez.
examples.trans: We saw a nine out of ten.

meanings.note: Written after street names in Spanish addresses (Calle Mayor número ocho).

examples.text: El número está aquí.
examples.trans: The number is here.

examples.text: Vemos los números desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the numbers from the door.

meanings.note: Las ocho = eight o'clock.

examples.text: Abrimos la puerta a las ocho.
examples.trans: We open the door at eight.

examples.text: La posada tiene ocho habitaciones.
examples.trans: The guesthouse has eight rooms.

meanings.note: Expresses surprise or realization.

examples.text: ¡Oh, ahí está la puerta azul!
examples.trans: Oh, there is the blue door!

examples.text: Oh, perdona, no te había visto.
examples.trans: Oh, sorry, I had not seen you.

oler.gloss: to smell (oler a = to smell of/like)

meanings.en: to smell (oler a = to smell of/like)
meanings.note: Irregular boot stem hue- (huelo, hueles, huele, huelen).

examples.text: La cocina huele a canela caliente.
examples.trans: The kitchen smells like warm cinnamon.

examples.text: El jardín huele a flores frescas.
examples.trans: The garden smells of fresh flowers.

meanings.note: A woman baker is la panadera; the shop is la panadería.

examples.text: El panadero empieza a trabajar a las cuatro.
examples.trans: The baker starts work at four.

examples.text: La panadera nos guarda dos barras de pan.
examples.trans: The baker keeps two loaves of bread for us.

meanings.note: Marks destination, recipient (para ti), deadline, and minutes to the hour (cinco para las doce).

examples.text: Este paquete blanco es para mi hermano.
examples.trans: This white parcel is for my brother.

examples.text: Faltan diez minutos para las doce.
examples.trans: It is ten minutes to twelve.

meanings.note: Feminine noun: la mejor parte.

examples.text: La parte está aquí.
examples.trans: The part is here.

examples.text: Vemos las partes desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the parts from the door.

meanings.note: General word for a baked layered or filled cake (pastel de almendra y frutos rojos).

examples.text: Queremos compartir otra vez el pastel de almendra y frutos rojos.
examples.trans: We want to share the berry almond cake again.

examples.text: Rocío sacó un pastel recién horneado para la merienda del sábado.
examples.trans: Rocio pulled a freshly baked cake from the oven for Saturday tea.

meanings.note: Traditional inner courtyard at the heart of a Spanish building.

examples.text: El patio está aquí.
examples.trans: The courtyard is here.

examples.text: Vemos los patios desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the courtyards from the door.

meanings.note: Hermano pequeño = younger brother; de pequeño = as a child.

examples.text: Es una pieza pequeña.
examples.trans: It is a small piece.

examples.text: Hay una pequeña tarjeta de cartón atada al asa.
examples.trans: There is a small cardboard card tied to the handle.

meanings.note: Tocar el piano = to play the piano.

examples.text: Por las tardes alguien toca una melodía suave en el viejo piano del salón.
examples.trans: In the afternoons someone plays a gentle melody on the old parlor piano.

examples.text: Hace veinticinco años daba clases de piano muy cerca de esta calle.
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I gave piano lessons very close to this street.

meanings.note: De piedra = made of stone.

examples.text: La piedra está aquí.
examples.trans: The stone is here.

examples.text: Vemos las piedras desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the stones from the door.

meanings.note: Plural las pieles; covers fruit peel (la piel del limón), human skin, and leather.

examples.text: La piel amarilla de este limón huele de maravilla.
examples.trans: The yellow peel of this lemon smells wonderful.

examples.text: Mateo guarda sus herramientas en una bolsa de piel.
examples.trans: Mateo keeps his tools in a leather bag.

meanings.note: Usually plural (unas pinzas) when referring to precision tweezers.

examples.text: Necesito unas pinzas finas para sujetar el pasador.
examples.trans: I need thin tweezers to hold the pin.

examples.text: Guarda las pinzas pequeñas en el bolsillo del maletín.
examples.trans: Keep the small tweezers in the toolkit pocket.

meanings.note: Participle of plastificar ('to laminate'); una carta plastificada wipes clean easily in cafés.

examples.text: Las cartas plastificadas del café no se manchan con el té.
examples.trans: The laminated café menus do not get stained by tea.

examples.text: Lleva su carné de la biblioteca en una funda plastificada.
examples.trans: He carries his library card in a laminated sleeve.

poner.gloss: to put; to set; to become (ponerse + adj)

meanings.en: to put; to set; to become (ponerse + adj)
meanings.note: Irregular: pongo, pon, puse, puesto; ponerse nervioso = get nervous.

examples.text: Pongo dos tazas limpias en la mesa.
examples.trans: I put two clean cups on the table.

examples.text: Pon la maleta junto al mostrador.
examples.trans: Set the suitcase beside the counter.

por.gloss: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)

meanings.en: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)
meanings.note: Por la mañana = in the morning; por favor = please; gracias por = thanks for.

examples.text: Paseamos por el casco antiguo.
examples.trans: We stroll through the old quarter.

examples.text: Por la mañana entra mucho sol.
examples.trans: In the morning plenty of sun comes in.

meanings.note: Shortens to primer before masculine singular nouns (el primer día); also used as adverb ('first').

examples.text: Hoy es mi primer día de trabajo.
examples.trans: Today is my first day of work.

examples.text: La primera habitación está libre.
examples.trans: The first room is vacant.

meanings.note: Covers room doors, street doors, and courtyard gates.

examples.text: La puerta está aquí.
examples.trans: The door is here.

examples.text: Vemos las puertas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the doors from the door.

meanings.note: Core connector and relative pronoun (unaccented, distinct from interrogative qué).

examples.text: Espero que descanses muy bien.
examples.trans: I hope that you rest very well.

examples.text: El pan de esta panadería huele genial.
examples.trans: The bread that The baker bakes smells great.

meanings.note: In the kitchen, una receta (de cocina) is a recipe; at a pharmacy or doctor's surgery, it means a prescription.

examples.text: Encontramos la mitad de una receta de bizcocho de almendra.
examples.trans: We found half of an almond sponge cake recipe.

examples.text: Esta sopa sigue una receta antigua de mi abuela.
examples.trans: This soup follows an old recipe of my grandmother's.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender and number.

examples.text: Es una pieza roja.
examples.trans: It is a red piece.

examples.text: ¡Dígales que la mía tiene una cinta roja en el bolsillo de arriba!
examples.trans: Tell them mine has a red ribbon in the top pocket!

meanings.note: Toallas secas = dry towels.

examples.text: Es una pieza seca.
examples.trans: It is a dry piece.

examples.text: ¡Javier lo dejó ahí cuando cogió la toalla seca!
examples.trans: Javier set it down there when he took the dry towel!

sobre.gloss: on; upon; about; out of (nueve sobre diez)

meanings.en: on; upon; about; out of (nueve sobre diez)
meanings.note: Sobre todo = above all / mostly; also a homograph noun el sobre ('envelope').

examples.text: Deja la llave sobre el mostrador.
examples.trans: Leave the key on the counter.

examples.text: Sacó nueve sobre diez en la prueba.
examples.trans: She scored nine out of ten on the test.

meanings.note: Conjugates like reír (sonrío, sonrió); imperative plural: ¡sonreíd!.

examples.text: La panadera siempre sonríe al abrir el horno.
examples.trans: The baker always smiles when opening the oven.

examples.text: Al probar el bizcocho, sonrió enseguida.
examples.trans: Upon tasting the cake, he smiled right away.

meanings.note: Hecho una sopa = soaked through.

examples.text: La sopa está aquí.
examples.trans: The soup is here.

examples.text: Vemos las sopas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the soups from the door.

meanings.note: The lid of a box, pot or piano; in a Spanish bar also a small plate of food.

examples.text: ¿Dónde está la tapa de la olla?
examples.trans: Where is the lid of the pot?

examples.text: Pedimos una tapa de tortilla.
examples.trans: We order a small plate of tortilla.

meanings.note: Sloping exterior roof covered in tiles.

examples.text: El tejado está aquí.
examples.trans: The tiled roof is here.

examples.text: Vemos los tejados desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the tiled roofs from the door.

meanings.note: Material for clothes, curtains or old cable covers.

examples.text: Esta camisa es de una tela muy suave.
examples.trans: This shirt is made of a very soft fabric.

examples.text: Compro tela para las cortinas.
examples.trans: I'm buying fabric for the curtains.

meanings.note: Shortens to tercer before masculine singular nouns (el tercer escalón).

examples.text: Es una pieza tercera.
examples.trans: It is a third piece.

examples.text: ¡Vamos, carrera hasta la tercera planta!
examples.trans: Come on, race you to the third floor!

meanings.note: Con tinta permanente = in permanent ink.

examples.text: La tinta es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The ink is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre la tinta.
examples.trans: We talk about the ink.

tocar.gloss: to touch; to ring (a bell); to play (an instrument)

meanings.en: to touch; to ring (a bell); to play (an instrument)
meanings.note: Preterite 1st sg spells c -> qu: toqué.

examples.text: Alguien acaba de tocar el timbre.
examples.trans: Someone just rang the bell.

examples.text: De niño tocaba el piano los viernes.
examples.trans: As a boy he played the piano on Fridays.

meanings.note: Todo el día = the whole day; todo el mundo = everyone; sobre todo = mostly.

examples.text: Todo está limpio y en su sitio.
examples.trans: Everything is clean and in its place.

examples.text: Camina todo recto por esta calle.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead down this street.

meanings.note: Treinta y cinco = thirty-five.

examples.text: Nos dan treinta días de plazo.
examples.trans: They give us thirty days' notice.

examples.text: Son las nueve y treinta y cinco.
examples.trans: It is nine thirty-five.

meanings.note: Accented té ('tea') distinguishes the noun from pronoun te ('you').

examples.text: El té está aquí.
examples.trans: The tea is here.

examples.text: Vemos los tés desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the teas from the door.

meanings.note: Forms: un (m sg), una (f sg), unos (m pl 'some/about'), unas (f pl).

examples.text: Quiero un café caliente, por favor.
examples.trans: I would like a hot coffee, please.

examples.text: Hay una mesa libre en el patio.
examples.trans: There is a free table in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Plural los valses.

examples.text: El piano suena precioso con este vals antiguo.
examples.trans: The piano sounds lovely with this old waltz.

examples.text: Un vals tiene siempre tres tiempos por compás.
examples.trans: A waltz always has three beats per bar.

meanings.note: Written as a single word (veinte + y + ocho -> veintiocho).

examples.text: La melodía cambia suavemente en el compás veintiocho.
examples.trans: The melody shifts gently in bar twenty-eight.

examples.text: Este mes de febrero tiene exactamente veintiocho días.
examples.trans: This month of February has exactly twenty-eight days.

meanings.note: El verano que viene = next summer.

examples.text: El verano está aquí.
examples.trans: The summer is here.

examples.text: Vemos los veranos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the summers from the door.

meanings.note: Changes to e before words starting with /i/ sound (i- or hi-).

examples.text: Servimos café caliente y pan fresco.
examples.trans: We serve hot coffee and fresh bread.

examples.text: Son las siete y cuarto.
examples.trans: It is quarter past seven.
